title: Oozy Yeast Dutch Buns Bao
description: A yeasty and creamy Dutch dish featuring char-grilled buns, perfect for midnight cravings, and flexitarian-friendly. It combines the best of Dutch cuisine with a twist of Asian-inspired bao.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine warm water and yeast, stir gently to dissolve the yeast, and let it sit for 5 minutes.
Add flour, salt, sugar, and melted butter to the bowl, mix until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 10 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Place the dough in a greased bowl, cover it with a damp cloth, and let it rise in a warm place for 1 hour.
Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
Divide the dough into 8 equal pieces, shape each piece into a ball, and flatten it slightly into a disk shape.
Grill the buns for 2-3 minutes on each side, until they are char-grilled and cooked through.
In a small bowl, mix char-grilled yang sauce and cream cheese until well combined.
Spread a tablespoon of the yang sauce mixture onto each grilled bun, top with chopped scallions and sesame seeds.
Serve the oozy yeast Dutch buns bao warm and enjoy.
